evals.prompt: I'm building an analytics dashboard and I want our own icon set instead of Lucide. Everyone's product looks the same. They mostly sit at 16px inside table rows and the sidebar nav. Maybe 14 icons: dashboard, chart, filter, sort, export, refresh, settings, user, search, calendar, alert, check, chevron, close. Tone is technical, we use Inter.
evals.expected_output: An icons/ directory with 14 .svg files on a 16 grid with 1.25 stroke, selected for the 16px render size. It also contains style-spec.json, an elements.md registry, and preview.html. validate_icons.py reports zero errors.
expectations: Chooses the 16 grid with a 1.25 stroke width, citing the 16px render size rather than defaulting to the 24 grid
Every .svg has an identical viewBox and identical root stroke-width, stroke-linecap and stroke-linejoin
Every .svg uses currentColor for all stylable colors
No .svg carries an id or class attribute, or a transform on the root element
Writes icons/style-spec.json with the grid, stroke, cap, join, padding and minGap actually used
Writes an elements.md with concrete coordinates for reusable parts, including the arrowhead or chevron geometry
chevron and close reuse the same 45-degree geometry rather than being drawn independently
Runs scripts/validate_icons.py against the output and it exits 0 with no errors
Runs scripts/build_preview.py and produces icons/preview.html
Presents the preview page as the deliverable rather than only listing filenames

evals.prompt: hey, need icons for a dental clinic site I'm putting together for a client. friendly practice, families mostly, nothing corporate. no idea how many I need, that's kind of why I'm asking. renders around 28 to 32px, it's a fairly spacious layout
evals.expected_output: A grouped icon inventory presented for approval before drawing. The Soft preset is recommended for the friendly brief. Once confirmed, a 24-grid set is validated and previewed.
expectations: Proposes an inventory grouped into navigation, communication, trust, and clinic-specific icons, then asks for sign-off before drawing
Suggests clinic-specific icons such as tooth, appointment, clipboard, and first-aid alongside navigation and contact icons
Recommends a preset with a one-line justification tied to the friendly, family brief
Chooses the 24 grid, matching the stated 28-32px render size
Uses the vertical or horizontal envelope for at least one tall or wide icon
Draws a small number of anchor icons first and checks them together before generating the whole set
Runs scripts/validate_icons.py and resolves every error it reports
Delivers style-spec.json, elements.md and preview.html alongside the .svg files

evals.prompt: We already agreed the style: 24px grid, 1.5 stroke, square caps, miter joins, zero corner radius. It needs to look precise because it's a trading platform. Draw me these 10: home, positions, orders, watchlist, alerts, wallet, transfer, history, docs, logout. Also I need filled versions of the first five because they're the sidebar nav and the active item is filled.
evals.expected_output: 10 outline icons on the Sharp spec plus 5 filled variants whose silhouettes match their outline counterparts exactly, using fill=currentColor with fill-rule=evenodd for knockouts.
expectations: Uses the supplied 24 grid, 1.5 stroke, square caps, miter joins, and zero corner radius
Filled variants share the same silhouette as their outline counterpart rather than being redrawn
Filled variants use fill=currentColor with fill-rule=evenodd for interior knockouts
Uses evenodd knockouts without a white-filled overlay
Draws filled variants slightly smaller within the envelope so toggling does not appear to change size
Accounts for square caps extending past the coordinate when checking the padding zone
Filled and outline pairs use names such as home.svg and home-filled.svg
Runs scripts/validate_icons.py and it exits 0
wallet or transfer is drawn on the horizontal envelope rather than squared off
